overview_description.description:
Vori is the only modern B2B operating system for the grocery industry. Vori's platform unlocks the data required for grocery retailers, brands, and distributors to effectively address food access and food waste while future-proofing their business operations with advanced technology. Their technology seamlessly connects data across the food supply chain, making supply chain management easy for retailers and their suppliers.

Vori was founded in 2019 and launched its first product in March 2020, at the height of the COVID-19 Pandemic. Vori is backed by investors who share their vision of a future where food moves freely. Their investors include Greylock, Y Combinator, Village Global, South Park Commons, grocery industry experts from Safeway/Albertsons, co-founders of Instacart, DoorDash, and Twitch, and strategic Vori customers. Learn more at vori.com.

product.description: A software suite that integrates supplier data to streamline ordering, receiving, and invoice processing for grocery stores.

product.name: VoriOS Automated Pricing Management
product.description: A system that automates margin protection and updates shelf prices instantly to reduce labor and pricing errors in grocery stores.

product.description: A built-in customer relationship management and loyalty program that tracks shopper habits and enables targeted marketing communications.

product.description: A PCI-compliant payment processing system supporting multiple payment forms including EBT, contactless payments, and gift cards.
